Creatinine is the metabolic byproduct of creatine. If you're working out regularly and you take creatine, it gets used to repair muscles. But if you're not working out and you take creatine, it gets metabolized to creatinine and excreted in the urine ... which, if you've done the other steps, is dilute AF, but yellow AF.
